I've tried it, and the app matches the behaviors we settled on. It opens clean and ready for my own links, with the save box up top, search across titles/descriptions/notes, the read-later area, and tags in the sidebar all where I'd expect. And I'm glad my saved bookmarks stick around between restarts — that's the whole point, that saving something no longer means losing it.

This does everything I set out wanting: save a link and have it come back recognizable, fix its details, organize with consistent tags and browse them, search that reaches into my notes, a read-later list I can check off, and getting back to the original page. Changing a stored address staying as a later request is fine with me.

Yes, I accept the application and I'm happy to complete this cycle. Thank you.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
